newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel opens Turkey logistics site.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel opens Turkey logistics site.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel AG said it has opened a new five million Swiss francs logistics terminal in Istanbul to serve the fast-growing Turkish market.

It added the new facility will provide its subsidiary, Kuehne & Nagel Nakliyat Ltd. Sti. with a 16,000 sq.metre terminal including 5,100 sq. metres of storage space for customs warehousing and freight handling.
The computer-supported warehousing system represents 25 percent more storage space than previously ,it said in a statement.
Part of the terminal is rented to a German department store company for which Kuehne & Nagel transports prepacked Turkish textile products to Germany.
Kuehne & Nagel Nakliyat Ltd. Sti. handles some 100 import and 40 export truckloads a week, mostly overland road transport to and from Western Europe, it added

Nearly 90 percent of its exports, mostly textiles and clothes, and 70 percent of imports are shipped between Turkey and Germany, it added. Other leading European exporters to Turkey are the Benelux states, France, Britain and Italy.
The main Turkish imports handled are chemical and pharmaceutical products, automotive parts and consumer goods. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
